name: SigMF Raw-IQ Capture Ingest Flow
description: Per-provider ingest flow, raw-IQ capture pointers: a cron TIMER tick enters at sigmf-captures:request, which emits ONE bulk hostcap/http-request GET of the configured archive's metadata index (default IQEngine https://www.iqengine.org/api/datasources/local/local/meta — anonymous, no token) rather than a per-file crawl of a community-run service. sigmf-captures:parse joins that job with the response and emits a size-prefixed $IQC record stream (batch = sha256 of the payload; SigMF hertz carried unconverted; DATATYPE verbatim; GEOLOCATION omitted when unpublished and REFUSED when the coordinates are out of WGS-84 range; licence per RECORDING, empty meaning unknown terms), and hostcap/storage-ingest persists it through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source cap op. $IQC is a POINTER RECORD: PAYLOADS carry the upstream URLs and hashes with CUSTODY UPSTREAM_ONLY, so no capture payload is ever mirrored by this flow. Results land on the egress sink. All decisions live in-wasm; the host supplies only the http and storage connectors.

edges._comment: NOT opaque: both ports resolve the concrete $IQC identity, so the record type is declared on the wire rather than signed away.

triggers.description: SigMF archive sync timer. WEEKLY: these archives grow by hand-contributed recordings over weeks, and one cycle pulls a ~31 MB index from a free community deployment, so a daily poll would be abuse with no new data to show for it.
